in_marathi.name: Rashmikant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Grace, Auspicious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rashmikant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rashmikant is derived from two Sanskrit words 'Ras' and 'Mikant'. Ras means 'essence' or 'taste' and Mikant means 'graceful' or 'auspicious'. This name is believed to be bestowed upon a child by the gods, symbolizing their blessings and grace.
